title: Bar Juice 5000 Menthol 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Bar Juice 5000 Menthol Nic Salt is a crisp and refreshing vape designed for fans of straightforward cooling flavours. This pure Menthol profile delivers a brisk, clean sensation on the inhale and a lingering coolness on the exhale, offering a reliable option for those who prefer their vape sharp, simple and satisfying. With its 50VG/50PG blend, this nic salt e-liquid delivers well-defined flavour and discreet vapour, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits, starter devices, and vape pens. The nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid absorption and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit—perfect for all-day vaping. Created to match the taste of popular menthol-style disposables, Bar Juice 5000 Nic Salts offer a more eco-conscious way to enjoy familiar flavours. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg strengths.
